rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload condition and flag alarm M191.
Reset fault flag M190 via fault reset pushbutton X1.
Evaluate station fault interlock M199 from faults and E-stop status.
Drive conveyor motor contactor Y10 in auto mode when fault-free.
Indicate pallet in position M100 from stop photo-eye X10.
Set stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of release request.
Time 2.0 s stopper release pulse using timer T11.
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 after timer T11 elapses.
